headline: Christian McCaffrey has mild hamstring strain, 49ers optimistic he'll play after bye
summary: The 49ers announced running back Christian McCaffrey had a thigh injury during Sunday's loss to the Falcons, but the diagnosis of his injury was different on Monday.

headline: Cardinals WR Jalen Brooks to miss rest of season with wrist injury
summary: Cardinals wide receiver Jalen Brooks posted on social media Monday that he will miss the rest of the season with a wrist injury.
